runAnswer.default:
## Card payments broke on tablets in release 4.12

Checkout conversion fell from 3.4% to 2.7% last week, a 21% drop [1]. All of it comes from the payment step on tablets, 41% of checkouts [2].

- Tablet conversion halved, from 3.5% to 1.8%
- Phones and desktops held steady at 3.3%
- 4.12 moved the card form into a frame without the payment permission [3]

```tsx
<iframe
  src={cardFormUrl}
  allow="payment"
/>
```

**Fix:** add the permission and ship 4.12.1 today.

logos.x-help: Wordmark, brand colour and the glyph in the mark beside it, or a logo image in their place.

eyebrow.x-help: Small line above the heading. Omit to drop it.

title.x-help: Heading above the wall. Omit to drop it.

arriveStaggerSeconds.x-help: Seconds between tiles arriving, in reading order. Deliberately fast.

staggerSeconds.x-help: Seconds between diagonals of the colour sweep.

warmSeconds.x-help: How long one tile takes to go from grey to brand colour.

accentColor.x-help: Eyebrow, and the fallback for logos with no colour.

backgroundColor.x-help: Leave empty to follow the theme.

title: End card
description: A closing card with a title, a button, your web address and social handles.

subtitle.default: Start free. No credit card needed.

cta.x-help: Button label. Omit to end on the title alone.

handles.x-help: Handles or channels listed along the foot.

backgroundColor.x-help: Leave empty to follow the theme.

defaultProps.title: Ready to try it?
defaultProps.subtitle: Start free. No credit card needed.

title: Code reveal
description: A code editor that types out a file, then highlights the lines that matter.

code.x-help: Source shown in the editor; surrounding blank lines are trimmed.

highlightedLines.x-help: Line numbers as shown in the gutter, focused once the listing finishes writing.

language.x-help: Language badge on the right of the header.

startLine.x-help: First line number in the gutter, for excerpts.

accentColor.x-help: Caret, focus band and glow color.

backgroundColor.x-help: Leave empty to follow the theme.

defaultProps.title: checkout.ts

title: Code diff
description: A code editor that applies a change line by line: removed lines collapse and new lines type in.

after.x-help: Source after the patch; the scene diffs the two.

wipeSeconds.x-help: Seconds the apply front takes to travel the file.

backgroundColor.x-help: Leave empty to follow the theme.

defaultProps.title: render.ts

title: Kanban board
description: A task board where cards move from one column to the next.

columns.x-help: Column headings, left to right. Cards address columns by index.

cards.x-help: Title, meta line, starting column, rail tint, and the one move the card makes.

moveSeconds.x-help: How long a card takes to arc from column to column.

dealStaggerSeconds.x-help: Seconds between each card's arrival during the opening deal.

accentColor.x-help: Destination column glow, and the fallback card rail.

backgroundColor.x-help: Leave empty to follow the theme.

title: File tree
description: A folder tree that opens one item at a time and highlights a file.

nodes.x-help: One path per item, like src/app.ts. End a folder with / to show it empty.

title.x-help: Title bar over the tree. Omit to drop the header.

selectedPath.x-help: Slash-joined path of the file that lights up at the end. Omit to select nothing.

rowStagger.x-help: Seconds between one row appearing and the next.

accentColor.x-help: Selected row's bar, tint and label.

backgroundColor.x-help: Leave empty to follow the theme.

title: File upload
description: A pointer drags a file into an upload area, which catches it and uploads it.

fileSize.x-help: Size shown once the upload completes.

siblings.x-help: Other rows in the source list.

label.x-help: Idle prompt in the drop zone.

hint.default: MP4 or MOV, up to 2 GB

activeLabel.x-help: Prompt while the file is held over the zone.

accentColor.x-help: Zone, cursor ring, and progress colour.

backgroundColor.x-help: Leave empty to follow the theme.

defaultProps.label: Drop your clip
defaultProps.hint: MP4 or MOV, up to 2 GB

title: Commit graph
description: A version history graph that draws its branches and merges commit by commit.

windowTitle.x-help: Text in the title bar. Omit to drop the chrome header.

stepSeconds.x-help: Seconds between commits. Each edge draws over this same gap.

accentColor.x-help: Trunk colour, and the branch ref chip.

laneColors.x-help: Colours for branch lanes 1 and up.

backgroundColor.x-help: Leave empty to follow the theme.

title: Notification stack
description: Notifications slide in, stack up and dismiss themselves.

default.title: Storage at 86%
default.body: Archive old renders to free space

toasts.x-help: Title, optional body and meta, tone, and optional per-toast arrival and dwell.

align.x-help: Corner the stack anchors to. Bottom anchors grow upward.

lifeSeconds.x-help: Default seconds a toast stays up before dismissing itself.

showProgress.x-help: Draining line along each toast's bottom edge.

accentColor.x-help: Colour used by the warn tone.

toasts.title: Storage at 86%
toasts.body: Archive old renders to free space

title: Device mockup
description: Shows the clip on a laptop, phone or browser screen while the camera slowly pulls back.

src.x-help: Shown on the screen when no clip is connected. Leave empty for a built-in demo screen.

title.x-help: Optional headline. When omitted, the device remains the sole focal point.

subtitle.x-help: Optional supporting line under the headline.

eyebrow.x-help: Optional accent label above the headline.

device.x-help: Mockup shell. Laptop includes a physical base, browser renders chrome only, phone renders a handheld frame.

title: Device lineup
description: Shows the clip on a phone, a tablet and a laptop side by side.

title: Handwriting
description: Writes the text out by hand, stroke by stroke.

penSize.x-help: Diameter of the nib, in em. 0 hides it.

inkSoftness.x-help: Softness of the ink edge, as a share of one glyph.

wobble.x-help: Per-character tilt and baseline drift, in degrees. Fixed, not animated.

staggerInFrames.x-help: Frames between one character and the next. This is the writing speed.

fontFamily.x-help: Project font follows the fonts set for the whole project.

fontSize.x-help: Leave empty to size the text to the frame.

title: Neon sign
description: Text that flickers on like a neon sign, then hums gently.

glowColor.x-help: Colour of the halo around the tube.

glowSize.x-help: Four stacked shadows, so it stays soft.

hum.x-help: Depth of the mains hum once the sign has settled.

buzz.x-help: Chance per beat that a settled tube stutters. 0 disables it.

flickerOnExit.x-help: Stutter back off instead of fading cleanly.

staggerInFrames.x-help: Frames between one tube striking and the next.

fontSize.x-help: Leave empty to size the text to the frame.

offColor.x-help: The tube with no gas lit: cold glass, not invisible. Leave empty for a faint glow colour.

title: Text mask
description: Big letters with a video, image or gradient showing through them.

text.x-help: The letterforms the media is seen through.

src.x-help: A video or image to show through the letters. Leave empty for the gradient.

reveal.x-help: Which way the letters are uncovered.

zoom.x-help: Extra scale the media breathes through. 0 holds it still.

fontFamily.x-help: Project font follows the fonts set for the whole project.

fontSize.x-help: Leave empty to fit the text to the frame.

title: Aurora
description: Soft ribbons of light drifting across a dark sky.

amplitude.x-help: Vertical travel of a fold, in percent of the frame.

thickness.x-help: Curtain height at its thickest point, in percent.

centerY.x-help: Where the band sits, in percent of the frame height.

blur.x-help: Much above 20 and the folds become blobs.

horizonGlow.x-help: Ground glow under the band. 0 removes it.

striation.x-help: Vertical ray structure through the curtains, 0-1.

title: Particle field
description: Glowing particles drifting at different depths.

angle.x-help: Direction of travel in degrees. 0 drifts straight up.

speed.x-help: Traverse speed. 1 crosses the frame in about eight seconds.

depthBlur.x-help: Defocus on the furthest particles. 0 flattens the field.

drift.x-help: Sideways wander, in percent of the frame.

glow.x-help: Halo per particle, as a multiple of its size. 0 draws hard dots.
